### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set: nothing moves. No schema, prop, published type or accepted value changes; the two new module-level constants in `config-field-renderer.tsx` (`FIELD_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, `useSafeConfigFieldTranslation`) are not exported. Public surface: none. Visible text changes only under non-en locales; the en word is unchanged at all three sites. Right.

Site 1, `DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`: right. The key `engine.form.selectEllipsis` is an existing row of Studio's own table, en `Select…` at `metadata-admin/i18n.ts:1988` and zh `请选择…` at `:4914`, already read by `SchemaForm.tsx:2151` and `:2179` and by `inspectors/InspectorComboField.tsx:148`. The hook `useMetadataLocale()` (a wrapper over `useObjectTranslation`) is called unconditionally at the top of the component (`:188`); `t(key, locale)` is a plain table lookup, not a hook, and the call at `:489` sits inside the config-field render helper, outside the two inner-scope `t` parameters at `:422` and `:673`. The import is from `../i18n.js`, the module that `check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs:866` registers with a `forwardedScope` of `metadata-admin/`, so the gate reads this call site. No new key, no new edge.

Site 2, `config-field-renderer.tsx`: right. `createSafeTranslation({ 'common.select': 'Select…' }, 'common.select')` is the same factory shape as the sibling `config-panel-renderer.tsx:80`. The hook call (`:79`) sits above the `visibleWhen` early return (`:82`), so the rules of hooks hold. `field.placeholder ?? t('common.select')` keeps an authored placeholder verbatim, and keeps an authored empty string as authored (`??`, as `ScreenView` does). `common.select` exists in all ten packs at the head (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh). `@object-ui/components` already declares `@object-ui/i18n` (`package.json:37`).

Site 3, `SettingsField.tsx`: right. `useObjectTranslation()` is called unconditionally at the top of the component (`:38`, right after `useId()`); the closed select's placeholder is `t('common.select', { defaultValue: 'Select…' })`, the same expression as the precedent `ScreenView.tsx:391`. `@object-ui/console` already declares `@object-ui/i18n` (`package.json:68`).

No locale pack, no designer table and no `package.json` in the nine-file diff (3 product files +38/-3, 5 test files +553, 1 changeset +15). Right.

Enumeration pin, `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/select-placeholder-literal-11252.test.ts`: sound. Scope: `packages/` and `apps/` (`console`, `site`) from a repo root derived from the file's own URL (depth 5, correct). It skips `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `coverage`, `__tests__`, `__mocks__`, `test`, `tests`, `e2e` and dot-directories, and `.d.ts`, `.test.`, `.spec.` and `.stories.` files. An offender is any string, template or JSX-text token matching `Select` plus U+2026 or three full stops that is not (a) a property value inside `packages/i18n/src/locales/`, (b) a property value under a dotted string key, or (c) the `defaultValue` property of an object literal passed as a call argument. Comments are trivia to the TypeScript scanner, and the `i.tsx` lit case proves a comment yields no token. The lit control plants seven offender shapes (a JSX attribute, `??` and `||` fallbacks, JSX text, an ASCII `placeholder:` property, a template, a pack-shaped row outside the packs) and demands exactly one offender from each, and the three allowed shapes plus prose must classify as vocabulary or nothing; a population control demands that the tree scan see a pack row, a table row and an inline default, so an empty walk cannot pass. It can fail: the dev's A1 to A3 each fail `finds no offender`. It is not a new CI gate: a vitest file in app-shell's existing `src/__tests__/`, run by `pnpm test --shard=N/8` (`ci.yml:943`), and all eight shards are `success` on this head, which is also the re-derivation of "exactly three sites" at the head. Breadth and brittleness: comments cannot trip it and fixtures under the skipped names cannot. Two margins, named and not faulted: (i) `demo/` and `examples/` directories are not skipped (`plugin-charts/examples`, `plugin-dashboard/demo`, `plugin-gantt/demo`, `plugin-grid/demo`, `types/examples`; nine scannable files today, none carrying the literal, or the shards would be red), so a future demo string `Select…` fails the pin with a message that names the fix, which is the family closing as intended rather than a false positive; (ii) the `inline-default` class allows a `defaultValue: 'Select…'` in the argument object of any call, not only a translation call, a narrow false negative that no shape in the family takes. The case-sensitive match leaves SQL `SELECT` alone.

Provider-less pin, `config-field-select-placeholder-no-provider-11252.test.tsx`: right. No provider and no `createI18n`: `useObjectTranslation` answers the raw key for the probe key, `createSafeTranslation` swaps in its fallback, and `defaults['common.select']` renders. The assertion reads `en.common.select` from the pack module (`@object-ui/i18n` exports `en`, `index.ts:120`), so the defaults row is compared with the en value rather than a retyped word: `Select…` on both sides, U+2026 on both sides. That is the `factory-default-drift` promise of `check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` (`:355`, `:2119`), and the shard run holds it at the head. It is its own file for the module-global-instance reason, the same convention as `config-panel-footer-no-provider-4750.test.tsx`, which exists at the head.

A3 restores the settings literal, so zh and the enumeration pin fail: 2, consistent. A4 deletes the defaults row, so only the provider-less leg fails (`t('common.select')` falls through to the key) while the population control still sees table rows from Studio's dotted table and inline defaults from `ScreenView` and `SettingsField`: 1, consistent.
